proof_body:
by
  intro a p q hp h
  have h1 : 1 - p ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hp)
  have h2 : p - 1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hp
  constructor
  · have e := h 1 le_rfl
    rw [Finset.Icc_self, Finset.sum_singleton] at e
    rw [eq_div_iff h1]
    linear_combination e
  · intro n hn
    have e := h (n + 1) (by omega)
    rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega), h n hn] at e
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff h2]
    linear_combination -e
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (p q : ℝ), p ≠ 1 → (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, a k = p * a n + q) → a 1 = q / (1 - p) ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → a (n + 1) = p / (p - 1) * a n
